A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

The main takeaway from our work is that

cDs are not intrinsically rounder than normal Es, and that their shape distribution is consistent with that expected from the ΛCDM model, at least for the mass range probed by the GIF2 simulations (Mvir ≃ 1015 M⊙).
the intrinsic axial ratio distribution of BCG galaxies is very similar to that of Es, with the only exception of the most elongated objects.
the intrinsic shape distribution (ellipticity distribution) of BCGs is consistent with that of dark matter haloes.
